excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin. Wears a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, white skirt and light blue pumps.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 leans over a dust-shielded workstation, steadily operating a thin pneumatic air-scribe tool against a block of dense light grey limestone matrix. Her focused work peels back the stony layer to isolate a long, robust sauropod rib bone belonging to a Cedarosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
